title: Bandai Namco to dissolve Reflector Entertainment, the Unknown 9: Awakening studio

sources.note: Bandai Namco Holdings notice 10 Nov 2026: board resolution to dissolve and liquidate Reflector Entertainment Ltd. (Montreal, Canada, est. 29 Dec 2015); reason: portfolio and development review, investment, profitability; extraordinary loss about 21 million euros (about 3.5 billion yen) from Q3 FY3/2027; schedule undecided

footage.files: Steam Unknown 9: Awakening Cinematic Launch Trailer (1080p, full frame)

claims.claim: Bandai Namco will dissolve and liquidate Reflector

gate: gate 06:40Z: Bandai Namco Holdings PDF read in full; no schedule; no staff count given

angle.hook: Bandai Namco is closing the studio behind Unknown 9: Awakening
angle.why_now: the board approved the dissolution on 10 Nov, two years after the game's release, with a loss of about 21 million euros expected
angle.what_it_means_here: no more Unknown 9 from this studio; the parent cites profitability
angle.payoff: the loss figure and that the timing is not set

story_items.layoffs: who: Reflector Entertainment, Montreal; what: dissolution and liquidation; reason as stated; staff count not given; figure: about 21 million euros loss

sensitive: none; neutral wording, no commentary on the game's reception
